added_failures_note: The reviewed run records no baseline_suite or after_suite block. The derived delta comes from its own two suite receipts: reader-tests.log at 2fd068df6030 plus working changes ran 31 tests with 0 failures, and focused-tests.log at ccda6bd1234 plus working changes ran 50 tests with 0 failures and EXIT=0, so no failure id is added and none is removed.

findings.text: assert_array_equal(loaded.values, check['signal'].values) compares two decodes of the one dict the mocked reader._request returns, so it stays true even if the loader stopped routing through ArchiveReader.read and fetched on its own; the divergence this test names would not redden it, and the guard that does fail is the one-fetch cache assertion at tests/remote/test_archive_signal_loader.py:106 together with the live gate's validity_same_samples measurement.

A held-value read whose first reply trips the client's reply-sample limit can never page, because held mode forbids expected_spacing and this branch then raises 'expected_spacing is required to verify raw pages'; imas_codex/remote/codac_uda.py:66-77 classifies that message as 'sampling' because it contains 'spacing', so a caller is told its cadence evidence was wrong when the truth is a volume refusal whose remedy is a narrower window.
